# Entry points

Everything that can be run directly.

| Kind | Module | How to run | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| cli | `import_jobs` | `python import_jobs.py` | Import roles from an external SQLite DB. |
| cli | `migrate` | `python migrate.py` | Import a tracker spreadsheet into jobs.db |
| cli | `seed` | `python seed.py` | Seed the tracker with demo data. |
| cli | `tracker_add` | `python tracker_add.py` | Add/update roles in the job tracker DB. |
| streamlit | `app` | `streamlit run app.py` | Streamlit frontend for the local job application tracker. |
